verdict.rationale: A prebuilt n8n, Zapier or similar no-code connector is a plausible offering for a SaaS scraping API, so this story applies to ScrapingBee. However, nothing in the evidence mentions n8n, Zapier, Make or any no-code integration. The CLI and MCP server cover developer and agent workflows, not prebuilt no-code connectors, so they do not count here.
